description: Counts words, characters, characters excluding whitespace, sentences, and paragraphs in a block of text, plus estimated reading time at 200 words per minute and speaking time at 130 words per minute. Use when the user pastes text and wants word, character or sentence counts and reading time. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive word counter calculator.
